title: Big Globe Compat - Nautec
description: This is a datapack that adds compatibility between Big Globe and Nautec.
body:
This datapack adds the strcutures and prismarine sand from Nautec to generate in Big Globe's terrain generation.

Prismarine sand can be found on both the beaches and in the oceans. Ruins generate in ocean biomes and below them in either the caves or deep dark are the crystal geodes.
